messages:
alex: Quick sync — can we align API/runtime/console/SDK versions for the 0.15 ship? Target cutoff: Fri 2026-03-20 20:00 PT. I'm tracking PRs that change public contracts and need version bumps. Plan: RC branch cut Thu, final cut Fri. Who's owning each repo?
maria: I can own API. PRs to include: #5123 (breaking header change), #5130 (docs). Need confirmation on semver minor vs patch.
cheng: Runtime has a small kv-cache refactor that should be patch: see #2117. But the ABI for serialized cache changed — might force a minor. I'll open an explicit bump PR if we decide minor.
sara: Console UI needs to pick up runtime API change — console PR #88 depends on new header behavior. If runtime goes minor, console should bump and we need a coordinated release. I can handle console side.
alex: @maria @cheng @sara ok — propose: runtime -> minor 0.15.0 -> runtime repo does v0.15.0, API stays 0.15.0, console 0.15.0, SDKs 0.15.0. If we want to avoid multiple minors, can we make runtime backward-compatible? Cheng?
cheng: I don't think it's safe without extra work. Option B: runtime publish v0.15.0-rc1 tomorrow, we do integration smoke tests, if green we tag final and we coordinate API + console bump PRs to use v0.15.0.
maria: SG. For API I'll open bump PR to v0.15.0 and add changelog entry. Will ping reviewers: @sara @cheng.
sara: I'll update console's package.json and create a canary build job. Adding a test to the integration suite to hit the new header path.
release-bot: Reminder: branch protection blocks direct pushes to main. Create release/* branches and request 'release-manager' review. Also, toggle to allow 'bypass-ci' label for emergency cut.
alex: Checklist: 1) Cheng opens runtime v0.15.0-rc1 PR by Wed EOD. 2) Maria opens API bump + changelog. 3) Sara opens console bump + canary job. 4) SDK owners (pinged in #devex) to update clients and publish artifacts. 5) Smoke-test matrix (integration) run before final tag. Who can be release-manager for Friday?
maria: I can be release-manager for Friday cut.
cheng: I'll do the rc and the smoke-test infra tweaks. Note: runtime CI flaky on long seq lengths — we'll skip those tests in smoke and run full suite post-cut.
sara: Linking PRs here when created.
alex: Thanks. Small note — remember to include changelog lines per the template, and add 'migration' note if header semantics change. If anyone needs help with the tag commands, paste example: `git checkout -b release/v0.15.0 && git tag -a v0.15.0 -m 'v0.15.0' && git push origin release/v0.15.0 && git push origin v0.15.0`
maria: :thumbsup: Will tag API once integration is green.
sara: I'll post canary links in this thread.
alex: Perfect. I'll follow up Thu AM to confirm branch cuts. Thanks all :rocket:
